receipts.last_text_witness: they're trying to play a game where someone changed all the rules without telling them. Housing costs have exploded. Education has become a luxury item and basic transportation now requires a small loan. The American dream didn't die, it just became prohibitively expensive. If you found this eye openening, make sure to subscribe and let me know in the comments what generational financial myth you'd like me to tackle next.
